agenda.2026-11-17-france-greve-fonction-: France: day of strikes and demonstrations, civil servants and young people together

The civil service inter-union group, joined by the CFDT on 13 November, is calling a strike to unfreeze the index point [1], and the unions behind the cost-of-living movement are calling for a new strike day on the same date [2]. In Paris, undeclared gatherings remain banned around ten high schools and five university sites until 20 November [3].
